section: Language II — English · బోధనా పద్ధతులు (Teaching Methods — Complete)
subject: Language II — English
stem: Encouraging students to read many self-selected story books of their own interest and level, purely for pleasure and to build fluency, without detailed comprehension questions or vocabulary drilling on every page, is called:
explanation: Extensive reading emphasises large quantities of self-chosen, enjoyable reading to build fluency and a love of reading — unlike intensive reading, which involves detailed, teacher-guided study of a short passage for language features and comprehension.
